objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Log in to NodeGoat, get the server to execute JavaScript of your own, and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The tutorial's A1 Injection section covers a server-side flaw in one of the logged-in pages. Which page takes numbers from you?
Look at how the server turns those form values into numbers: which dangerous JavaScript function is involved?
